manifest.config_yaml:
experiment_settings:
  seeds: [101]
  use_msa_server: false
  use_templates: false
pl_trainer_args:
  devices: 1
  num_nodes: 1
  precision: 32-true
model_update:
  presets: [predict]
  custom:
    settings:
      memory:
        eval:
          use_triton_triangle_kernels: false
          use_deepspeed_evo_attention: false
          use_cueq_triangle_kernels: false
manifest.cache: Weights hashed before request; filesystem warm; fresh model; no MSA or template search
manifest.timing_scope: Request excludes imports, weight hashing and device preflight; includes upstream setup/loading/features/prediction/writing and raw output capture. Stage times are inclusive.

limitations: One instrumented fresh-process observation, not a repeated latency result.
All exported fields are finite; native repeat variation and candidate full-model agreement remain unmeasured.
Query-only MSA, no templates, one diffusion sample; development workload only.
next_priority: The initial baseline/operator-screen cycle is closed. Rebuild the framework in Rust before resuming OpenFold3 optimization.
